cohort: 11 women who underwent endovascular embolization for life-threatening postpartum hemorrhage due to severe perineal tears at Fundacion Valle del Lili in Cali, Colombia between 2011 and 2016.
finding: Percutaneous endovascular embolization was a safe and effective third-line treatment option for controlling difficult-to-manage postpartum hemorrhage in patients with severe perineal tears.
